All the best,  
Beechwood Veterinary Group

Hi,
Thank you for a great review and lovely feedback. It means a lot to us.
All the best,
Beechwood Veterinary Group

We've been with Beechwood Vets for out little Shih Tzu Gonzalez for over 6 months now, and every time we've been made to feel really welcome by the reception staff (despite our dog being reactive!). The care that our dog has received so far has also been excellent, with great care and explanations.

I've visited three or four times now with my 9 month old kittens, and it's always been a stress-free experience. As a small practice it's never full of other animals in the waiting room, and I love that the vet is happy for my three cats to run all around the surgery room to help them settle. It never feels rushed. Really lovely staff.

I visited this morning with my cat. Lucy is always so lovely and helpful upon arrival and Lauren was brilliant at assessing her and letting us know the next steps. I always love coming to Beechwood as there is a caring approach, thank you so much Lucy and Lauren!!
Reasonably priced , convenient opening hours with a variety of sites to choose from. Caring compassionate staff from reception staff, to vet nurses and vets. Thoroughly recommended

We changed to this vets recently and couldn’t be happier with our decision. The staff were so kind to our cat and took time to listen to the complicated history of his thyroid problem. We were also able to book an appointment easily, whereas with our previous vet it had been difficult to book anything less than a month ahead. Highly recommend.

Lovely vets surgery who always treat our anxious boy with love and care 🐈
The front desk staff and veterinary staff are all lovely and caring 🧡 …
Really friendly vet clinic. Staff are very caring and communicative re: your pet.
Lovely and caring during a difficult time getting Bandit put to sleep. Becki rearranged another appointment so all the people that loved her could come along.

From Kat at the front desk helping out customers with general quieries to the Vetrinarian Becky who was more than welcoming to a shy kitten. I was amazed by the experience these two lovely ladies helped create and will be using this vet for all my animal needs. Thank you again for everything :)

Kind staff🩵🩵🩵 …

Hi Lelia,  
Thank you for the great review. We really appreciate it.  
All the best,  
Beechwood Veterinary Group
Excellent service with reasonable prices.
Lovely staff, compassionate care and reasonable prices.  My cat, Casper,  is a little hard to handle, but the nurses were excellent with him.  I recommend this veterinary practice very highly.
My cat injured his mouth an hour before the vets closed and the treatment here was amazing!!! The vet quickly helped the issue and checked him out, couldn’t recommend them more :))))

We had our first visit a few weeks ago for a check up by the vet. Our poodle, Betsy, had been very nervous at our previous surgery
so we were a bit worried as to how she would be.
From the moment we walked in, the staff were so welcoming and kind to Betsy. They made a real fuss of her and it was such a relief that she wasn't the nervous wreck that she had been previously. The surgery itself is very bright and clean and everyone we met was lovely. Thank you so much for not just calming Betsys nerves but ours too 😊

I brought my beautiful, handsome boy, Trigger the dog here recently having previously been registered with another vet in Horsforth.  On and off for two years they had given him an anti-inflammatory and short courses of steroids and antibiotics but he just got steadily worse. I'd had enough when on a visit there, the vet didn't even touch him-he just peered at him from a distance.
I knew Trigger would be better off at Beechwood in Headingley as I have another dog and a cat registered there. Very sadly, he had to be put down by vet Becki but he was treated with such care and compassion, as if he were her own dog. Becki and Julie made an awful experience so much more bearable.
I've lived in different places so have been registered with different vets over the years but I've never come across a practice that has staff who actually genuinely seem to care and their small acts of kindness are actually quite big and make such a huge difference.
I wouldn't go anywhere else and if the staff I've seen so far ever move, without sounding like a stalker, I may have to track them down...I can highly recommend Beechwood vets in Headingley.
Very caring

"I take my dog, Taffy, to Beechwood Vets in Headingley for her annual vaccinations and health checks. The staff are always incredibly thorough, carefully checking everything and explaining any health concerns clearly. When Taffy needed surgery, they gave us an appointment straight away. Today, she had her surgery, and I couldn’t be more impressed.

The reception staff and the entire team were so kind, helpful, and understanding. A particularly lovely lady at reception was so compassionate when I was worried and crying—she took the time to calm me down and reassure me, which meant so much. Their calm and caring attitude made Taffy feel at ease too. The surgery went smoothly, and I’m so grateful for the excellent care they provided.

Thank you to everyone at Beechwood-headingley surgery – you’re truly amazing!"

I’ve been coming to the Headingley Beechwood Vets since it opened with my cat and they are brilliant with her. She’s usually nervous at the vets but the staff all set her at ease, let her adjust and she gives her blood sample with no bother now. Highly recommend this vets!
Always friendly and helpful whenever I visit.
Very helpful, friendly staff.
Great service..both my dog and kitten go here..recently got my kitten neutered..all the staff were brilliant..would highly recommend beechwood vets ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Couldn't be happier with our first visit to Beechwood Vets, Headingley. Took our puppy for their first check up and vaccinations. The staff were all lovely and made the vet visit as positive as possible! They were happy to answer all of our questions and took time to do so.

Nice modern branch of Beechwood vets. Reception staff (Julie?) was particularly welcoming and warm. Genuine pet lovers and made us feel very welcome and relaxed on arrival

Separate cat and dog waiting areas with bowls for drinking and comfort cat blankets for carrier on request (with clear signs to advise)
